text: The powder is dissolved in warm water, the melted milk fat is mixed in, and the emulsion is homogenised and heated like any milk.

steps.name: hydrate
steps.note: The mix, at up to 35–40 % solids, is held at no more than 48–55 °C for up to 3 h before heating.

steps.name: melt
steps.note: The milk fat, which has no water in it, is kept in its cans, standing in hot water.
The fat is mixed into the base, which is at 45–50 °C.
Instead it can be ultra-high-temperature treated, at 138–140 °C for 4 s.
